name: @omadia/channel-teams
description: Microsoft Teams channel plugin for the byte5 Harness. Implements @omadia/channel-sdk's ChannelPlugin contract: Bot-Framework adapter, Adaptive-Card rendering, roster + mention resolution, attachment persistence with signed-URL proxy, and HTTP routes for /api/messages + /attachments. Depends on @omadia/integration-microsoft365 for shared Graph client and App-registration credentials.
